title: Add and remove classes
summary: A class name lets CSS handle the appearance.
introduction: A class name lets CSS handle the appearance. Your task: Remove bright after adding it.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for add and remove classes

blocks.text: A class name lets CSS handle the appearance. jQuery can add or remove that name without rewriting the stylesheet.
Use a local HTML page that loads jQuery 3.7 before these scripts. Examples need that library; the plain playground does not include it. Put the script after the example markup.
Read the code step by step

items: `addClass` adds a class name to the jQuery selection. CSS still defines what that name looks like.

blocks.text: The note becomes gold through its bright class.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Pass the class name without a dot. A dot belongs in a selector, not the addClass value.
